test.title: All pair-local mirror boundary alternatives

parameters.bip39Tokenization: Lowercase unfiltered lexical words; ordinary punctuation boundaries; invalid decoded group ␞ is a hard region boundary.
parameters.hexMatching: 64hex scalar records require non-hex boundaries; WIF and minikey shape windows may be embedded in a longer string.
parameters.geometry: Frozen token-box centers inverse-rotated to upright page; horizontal page reflection only.
parameters.centerDomain: Closed axis-aligned square [x-g,x+g] × [y-g,y+g] in original upright pixels.
parameters.maskDomain: Exact union of frozen horizontally reflected half-open rectangles [left,right) × [top,bottom).
parameters.membership: in if every point of the closed center square is in mask union; out if no point is; unknown otherwise.
parameters.selection: First/last possible selected word before the first guaranteed-in word; include no-word option iff no guaranteed-in word exists.
parameters.coupling: Independent uncertain memberships/row choices overapproximate correlated measurement errors; no likelihood or calibration claim.
parameters.emptyRow: Omit row when the no-word alternative is chosen; no padding or replacement text.

test.negativeCriterion: A complete zero-result run excludes only the declared literal records from the registered pair-local modeled superset, at the pinned source/code bytes. It does not calibrate scan errors, test global concatenation or exhaust mirror/first-word ciphers.
limitations: The 12-pixel and frozen center guards are review heuristics, not statistically calibrated measurement-error bounds.
Independent memberships admit physically inconsistent joint choices. This broadens the tested set and supplies no evidence of intentional encoding or candidate likelihood.
Global concatenations across page-pair readings are deferred; their large path count is not silently tested or ruled out.
Exact rectangle masks and the center-based selection convention are declared assumptions, not creator-specified instructions.

candidatePrivacy: Raw readings and locators remain private if any serialized private record validates. Public fingerprints are domain separated, never a raw minikey SHA-256. A checksum pass is a lead, not a prize claim.
